{{Quote|If yousa tinken Gungans need to be more war like, yousa come see me and bring weapons. If yousa thinken wesa Gungans should be saddled like kaadu, then yousa come see meesa so Isa can spit on you. Ptuh!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hassk (Gungan)|Hassk]]|<ref name="10HSTG" />}}
The '''Rorian Gungans''', best known as the '''Rorgungans''', were an extremist faction of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] active on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] before and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Yousa Gungans no wanna deal with them Imperials no more? Yousa tinken them Naboo Gungans actuh like helpless nuna? Isa say we take Rori.|Captain Hassk|<ref name="10HSTG" />}}
[[File:Rorgungans.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rorgungans patrolling near the [[Gungan Swamp Town]].]]
The Rorgungans were a group of Gungans from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who opposed [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass's]] support of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo's human population]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Violently opposed to any alliance between humans and Gungans, they to Naboo's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], to live in isolation from the outside world. They were very xenophobic and would try to kill any outsiders who approached them.<ref name="CDAG" /> They had established a [[Gungan Swamp Town]] deep in the heart of the [[Lake Octir Swamp|swamps]] of Rori.<ref name="CDAG" />

During the Galactic Civil War, the Rorgungans entered in resistance against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that controlled the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Rorgungan commander [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hassk (Gungan)|Hassk]] intended to recruit Gungans from Naboo to support the Rorian Gungans in their fight.<ref name="10HSTG" /> He was based in the Gungan Swamp Town, along with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]] [[Ori (Gungan)|Ori]] and [[Heb Nee]].<ref name="SWG:RGST" /> Around the same time, the Rorgungans were also in open conflict with the [[Rori Spice Mining Collective]].<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref> Another notable Rorgungan was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pir'pwn]].<ref name="SWG:GRC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Glowing Rock Collection}}</ref>
